method.anchor: Friday close = last feed round at or before Saturday 12:00 UTC; reopen = the next round.
method.live: A weekend is listed, live, from Friday 16:00 New York; until Friday 20:00 New York its close is the latest round so far.
method.pool: Per stock and weekend, the USDG pool with the most in-range USDG swap volume between the Friday close and the reopen; ties or no volume fall back to the deepest pool today.
method.thinSwaps: Swaps whose in-range virtual USDG is below 100 are excluded and counted.
method.range: Weekend range = low/high of hourly closing pool prices; single-swap extremes are reported separately.
method.decoupled: A weekend is flagged decoupled when the pool's last price is more than 10% from the reopen; it is shown but left out of summary stats.
